blocks.html: A rewarding experience awaits shoppers and health buffs as Robinsons Galleria –Ortigas celebrates Health and Wellness Fair from July 11 -15, 2016 at the Mall’s Activity Area. Get the chance to try out generous product samples and demos, or bring home special giveaways, and good health and wellness finds from partner merchants- Envy Me Salon and Spa, Excelsoir Organic Spa, GNC, Olympic Gold, World Balance, Il Padrino Coffee, Robinsons Department Store and Robinsons Supermarket. What’s more, the health conscious can look forward to Sexy Chef’ Barni Alejandro-Rennebeck’s show on July 16 at Robinsons Galleria – Ortigas Activity Area, 3-5 PM. Health enthusiasts are in for a hearty and guilt-free meals cooking demo and crash course on kitchen tips. The Sexy Chef, established in 2004, started as a diet food delivery service catering to residents of Metro Manila and gradually became one of the country’s premiere diet and health food provider. Chef Barni Alejandro-Rennebeck, a mother and graduate of the International School of Culinary Arts and Hotel Management, creates all of Sexy Chef’s healthy and nutritious recipes with the assistance of a nutritionist. She is also the author of the hit Eat, Clean , Love Cookbook. To know more about Health and Wellness events, follow Robinsons Mall Robinsons Malls in Facebook: www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter:@RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial.
